description: LiveDataLink is an MCP server giving AI agents instant access to 257 tools across 56 US public-data domains: sanctions/KYC screening, FMCSA carrier safety, SEC EDGAR, federal & state courts, cybersecurity/CVE, FEMA disasters, FRED macro, EIA/oil & gas energy, US Treasury, Census, FDA, EPA, FEC, USAspending, NPI healthcare, patents, nonprofits, real estate, plus scored cross-source due-diligence combos. Resale-safe public data. One server, one bearer key, free tier (1,000 queries/month, no card).
